title: Spanish Baked Eggs with Tomato, Peppers and Chorizo
summary: A warm Spanish-style breakfast of eggs baked in a smoky tomato and pepper sauce with slices of chorizo. It’s rich, savoury, and perfect with bread for soaking up the sauce.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Warm the olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
Add the chorizo and cook for 2–3 minutes until it starts to release its oil and turn lightly crisp at the edges.
Stir in the onion and peppers and cook for 6–8 minutes, until softened.
Add the garlic and smoked paprika and cook for 30 seconds, stirring so it does not catch.
Pour in the canned tomatoes, season with salt and black pepper, and simmer for 5–7 minutes until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Spoon the sauce into a small baking dish or ovenproof skillet. Make 4 wells in the sauce and crack in the eggs.
Bake for 8–10 minutes, until the whites are just set and the yolks are still a little soft, or longer if you prefer them firmer.
Scatter over the parsley and serve immediately.
